professors.title: Research Director and Core Investigator (Principal Investigator)
professors.institution_name: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
professors.department_name: Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology (A*STAR IMCB)
professors.evidence_quote_or_summary: Official A*STAR IMCB Core Investigators listing (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/imcb/people/core-investigators) lists 'Nick BARKER - Epithelial stem cells and cancer' as a Core Investigator (Principal Investigator), and his official profile (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/imcb/people/nick-barker) states he 'is currently a Research Director at IMCB' and publishes 'Email: Nicholas_Barker@a-star.edu.sg'. AGS eligibility for such A*STAR co-supervisors is stated on the official scholarship page (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/scholarships/home/scholarships/ags--scholarship): 'Scholars will be jointly supervised by both the A*STAR and University supervisors' and 'the main and co-supervisors should hold at a minimum, the designation of Principal Investigator or Principal Scientist at an A*STAR RI.'

professors.evidence_quote_or_summary: Official A*STAR IMCB Core Investigators listing (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/imcb/people/core-investigators) lists 'Valerie YANG - Translational precision oncology laboratory' as a Core Investigator (Principal Investigator), and her official profile (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/imcb/people/valerie-shiwen-yang) states she has 'joint appointments as a Research Clinician and Principal Investigator of the Translational Precision Oncology Laboratory in the Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology (IMCB), Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)', publishes 'Email: yangswv@a-star.edu.sg', and notes she 'is mentor to A*STAR MB/PhD scholars at the A*STAR Graduate Academy' whose AGS scholarship page (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/scholarships/home/scholarships/ags--scholarship) states 'Scholars will be jointly supervised by both the A*STAR and University supervisors' with A*STAR co-supervisors holding 'at a minimum, the designation of Principal Investigator or Principal Scientist at an A*STAR RI.'

notes: Live research (Oct 2026): The official AGS page (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/scholarships/home/scholarships/ags--scholarship) confirms joint supervision: 'AGS is a collaboration between A*STAR and local Autonomous Universities (AUs). Scholars will be jointly supervised by both the A*STAR and University supervisors' and requires applicants to 'identify and engage both an A*STAR researcher and a university faculty member', with the FAQ adding that main/co-supervisors 'should hold at a minimum, the designation of Principal Investigator or Principal Scientist at an A*STAR RI.' The AGS 'Research Projects' listing page (https://www.a-star.edu.sg/scholarships/home/research-projects) renders its project/supervisor browser only through client-side JavaScript, so individual projects could not be read via static fetch (source_requires_rendering for that listing). Potential A*STAR co-supervisors were instead verified from official A*STAR Research Institute people pages (a-star.edu.sg), all three from A*STAR IMCB Core Investigators with emails published on their official profiles. A university-side co-supervisor must additionally be identified by the applicant from the partner autonomous university (NUS/NTU/SMU/SUTD/SIT); no fixed university faculty are named by A*STAR for this scheme.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official NUS Graduate School page (https://nusgs.nus.edu.sg/scholarships/nus-research-scholarship, rendered in browser) describes a university-wide scholarship with no named supervising professors: 'Scholarship Provider: NUS Graduate School', 'Scholarship holders can pursue any graduate programmes' (all NUS PhD/MR programmes), and application deadlines are referred to 'faculty websites'. The only contact published is the administrative inbox nusgsenquiry@nus.edu.sg (NUS Graduate School office), which is not a supervising professor. No professor is tied to this scholarship on any official page, so no verified supervisor could be recorded.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official source (https://cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk) is the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK, which states it 'is an executive non-departmental public body, sponsored by the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office' and operates under the Commonwealth Scholarship and Fellowship Plan. CSC is the central UK government scheme: applicants are nominated through national nominating agencies and study at participating UK universities of their choice (see CSC 'UK universities' and 'National nominating agencies' partner pages), so no single institution or supervising professor is attached to the scheme. Not applicable per batch rules for national/government schemes. (Note: the input description text appears to describe NUS terms, but the official source URL and scheme identity are the UK CSC.)

Live research (Oct 2026): The official NUS Graduate School page (https://nusgs.nus.edu.sg/scholarships/presidents-graduate-fellowship, rendered in browser) describes a university-wide PhD fellowship selected by the University each semester, with no named supervising professors: 'Scholarship Provider: NUS Graduate School' and 'Scholarship holders can pursue any graduate programmes'. The only published contact is the administrative inbox nusgsenquiry@nus.edu.sg, not a professor. No faculty/supervisor is tied to this fellowship on any official page, so no verified supervisor could be recorded.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official NUS Office of Admissions page (https://nus.edu.sg/oam/scholarships/scholarships-for-freshmen-international-students/nus-international-undergraduate-scholarship, rendered in browser) is a University-Level freshmen undergraduate scholarship ('Scholarship Type: University-Level', 'Student Type: Freshmen') considered through the undergraduate admission application; the page text contains no mention of 'supervisor' or 'professor'. As a bachelor's-level admissions scholarship it carries no research supervision, and no faculty member is tied to it on any official page.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official NTU page (https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/undergraduate/scholarships/scholarship-opportunities/detail/nanyang-scholarship) states: 'The Nanyang Global Scholarship is awarded to outstanding freshmen pursuing undergraduate programmes' and is applied for through the undergraduate admission application; the only referee required is 'a school teacher, who must not be your family or relative'. No professor or supervisor is named or tied to this undergraduate scholarship on any official page.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official NTU page (https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/graduate/financialmatters/scholarships/npgs) describes the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship as a university-wide NTU PhD scholarship that 'is by nomination only', awarded across all NTU schools, with selection and interviews conducted by the University. No supervising professor or faculty member is named or tied to this scholarship on the official page (or the graduate scholarships index page it links from), so no verified supervisor could be recorded.
